name: Mah Jongg Mondays (Cary Regional Library)
description: Wake County Libraries drop-in program at Cary Regional Library (Cary, NC). Library's own page says: "Drop-in and play American Mah Jongg every 2nd and 4th Monday, 9:30 to 11 a.m." Players need a basic understanding of American Mah Jongg and a 2026 Mah Jongg card; sets provided; no registration.
